steps.speaker: [Vlog update time]
steps.content: 7:00 p.m., January 26, N.F. 113

steps.speaker: News
steps.content: At 4:38 p.m. on the 26th, an abnormal incident took place in Dillywood. A giant bathtub fell from the sky and struck the roof of a historic hotel in the area.

steps.speaker: News
steps.content: The bathtub disappeared after 58 minutes. No one was injured, but an unidentified blue creature was sighted at the scene.

steps.speaker: News
steps.content: <size=32>The FAC has cordoned off Dillywood and the surrounding areas. They also escorted away the film star Janet, who had checked into the hotel that same day. According to reports, Janet has recently been working on a horror film that features the bathtub in many scenes...</size>

steps.speaker: News
steps.content: According to an FAC spokesperson, recent investigations into abnormal incidents across Dillywood have encountered many manmade obstacles, so a large number of threats have not been dealt with in a timely manner.

steps.speaker: News
steps.content: There is still no word on Director Deren. While her studio has declined all interviews, the media is paying close attention to her personal safety...

steps.speaker: News
steps.content: As the current situation holds, the 41st DisCars Film Festival has already been seriously impacted. We're waiting for official word from DisCity Film Academy on whether it will be postponed or canceled...

steps.speaker: Dean
steps.content: There's no Mania, no Mania at all! We've invited Deren! Deren is making a comeback! She's coming to the DisCars tomorrow! Everyone come and see...

steps.speaker: Dean
steps.content: The DisCars will be held as usual! There are no monsters! Dillywood is very safe!! Don-Don't leave! Don't cancel your sponsorships!!

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: The main body has sped up its pace of releasing and retrieving clones. It's also getting closer and closer to Dillywood. Did all the attention generated by the DisCars attract the Apostle?

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Stella is an even stranger case... Not only did it not get the same powers as the other clones, the main body doesn't seem to be affecting it... Has Stella been abandoned?
It seems the effects between Apostles and humans are mutual. They need concentrated and similar spiritual energy to maintain stability. Stella and its "host" are really odd ones out...
Will they be a breakthrough against the main body... or another hidden threat...?
However, there are other things to worry about right now.
The rambunctious lion dancing girl had settled down in front of the TV, her eyes glued to the screen as she listens to the news about the DisCars. No one knows what she's thinking at this moment.
The heavy atmosphere makes Lynn feel like she's sitting on pins. She goes to Director D, who is sleeping soundly on the folding chair, and timidly tugs her sleeve.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: ...If Dillywood gets locked down, would the DisCars also...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: If that happens, what will OwO do... All this hard work of hers is for the DisCars. Do you have any ideas, Director?
D doesn't respond. She snores lightly with the script draped over her face. Lynn doesn't dare to shake her any harder. Just then, someone reaches out and yanks the script off her face.
Exposed under the light, D's eyes are already open. She keeps staring at the ceiling. It takes her quite a while to turn to OwO, who is standing in front of her.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: ...A lot of blue critters that look like Stella are attacking Dillywood. The police are busy catching them. Plus, the DisCars might not get held anymore...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Is that true, Director?

steps.speaker: Stella
steps.content: Squeak...

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: Hehe... The delay is a good thing. We can take a rest... I haven't worked so much in a long time. Feels like I'm about to break...

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: But after all this, this year's DisCars will probably become a big scandal. Hehe, those who burned loads of money for an award are screwed... If they win, it'll be a blot on their record. Who'd promote an award from the "cursed year"...?

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: Hehehehe... That old fart from the film academy is going to go bankrupt...

steps.speaker: Daisy
steps.content: Hey... Can't you say something nice at a time like this? OwO's face has gone completely dark after hearing it.

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: Oh, sorry, sorry. I wasn't fully awake just now. Forget what I said, I was just sleep talking. You didn't hear anything.
She stretches and sits up.

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: Don't worry, this is a great thing for OwO. It's a stroke of fate to help us make the best movie there is.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: The best movie there is?

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: That's right. A story can't be smooth sailing all the time. A movie without ups and downs will put people to sleep. Dreams will always clash with reality. There will always be one obstacle after the next, and an unbridgeable gulf before us.

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: You want to send Stella home, but now it might be the "monster" that threatens the city. You want to win a DisCar, but the award podium is about to get smashed.

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: My dear little scriptwriter, actress and hero... This is your unbridgeable gulf. This is also the exciting ending you wanted. What do you want to do about it?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: ...What would a movie hero do?

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: A movie hero? She'd press on, crossing the gulf to uncover the truth. She'd overcome the gravest obstacles, and most importantly, not give up on her dreams.

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: This way, the audience will come to like her, and believe in her goal and quest. This way, they'll feel involved in the story and root for her wish to come true.

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: And when the quest gets to the end and the story reaches its climax, the hero should overcome all obstacles to realize her wish, and satisfy the audience who's rooting for her.

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: This kind of heroic story is what's most popular at the DisCars. To please the audience, the protagonist never stops chasing her dreams. To be honest, it's quite tiring... haha.

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: But luckily, those are just movies, and we're in reality. We can take it easy... So, what do you plan to do?
She goes deep into thought. It's the first time she's ever thought so hard.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: ...I've found the ending I want.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I'm going to uncover the truth, and tell everyone that the creatures attacking Dillywood aren't monsters, but Stella's family. They're only rampaging through our world because they're sad and angry about not finding Stella.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: We have to go to Dillywood and bring Stella back to them. That way, they won't be angry anymore, Stella can go home, and the DisCars won't be ruined.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: We'll record all our hard work and put it into the film. Everything's real, and everyone will believe it. I'll find the best ending and make everyone happy.
She lifts up her head, her eyes sparkling.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I'll be the hero! I won't give up on my dream. I'm going to win a DisCar, and let everyone in Goldionville and the world know my story!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Right, Stella? Right, ${PlayerName}?

As she experiences her epiphany, she subconsciously looks over to the first two members of her dream team for support. Stella stares back blankly, while you stand silently in the corner. After a long time, she gets a slight, hesitant nod from you.
OwO takes the nod as a precious affirmation. She looks over again at D, the trusty director who symbolizes "Dillywood" and "film."

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I've made up my mind. This is the film I want. Director, you're with me, aren't you?

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: Hehe... of course. I knew you'd give me something interesting.
She takes OwO's little hand, goes down on one knee, and looks into the girl's eyes. D has finally opened up her squinted eyes, yet for some indescribable reason, her smile seems quite eerie.

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: Keep up this drive, sweetie. A good story will be full of pain and surprises. Things won't always be smooth. But the hero's fate has long been destined. She must chase her dream till the end of the film.

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: You're the hero of the story, so you've already lost the right to give up. If you let go, your film will die and be consigned to the dustbin of history. It'll be a long, painful journey. Not everyone can make it to the end.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hehe... I know, I won't give up! With you guys by my side, I'll definitely come back with a DisCar in my hands! Then, I'll take our movie and show it all over the world!

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: Mmm... I like your movie. I really hope it gets finished.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: <size=32>Chief, a message from the FAC. The Mania scan is complete, and the location of the epicenter has been confirmed. We speculate that the main body will cross into reality and concretize into form when the Mania reaches its peak. That'll be the time of attack.</size>

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: The time is 5 a.m. tomorrow. The location is the Dillywood Walk of Fame.
